name: Kelly Morrison
summary:
Kelly Louise Morrison (born February 2, 1969) is an American physician and politician who has served as the U.S. representative for Minnesota's 3rd congressional district since 2025. A member of the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party, she served from 2019 to 2023 in the Minnesota House of Representatives and from 2023 to 2024 in the Minnesota Senate.
An obstetrician-gynecologist who practiced in Minnesota for more than 20 years, Morrison was elected to Congress in the 2024 House elections, succeeding Dean Phillips, and is the first OB-GYN who supports abortion rights to serve in Congress.
